subject.title: experimental.sessionMemory does not surface gateway-dispatched sessions in memory_search

question: Should OpenClaw accept owner-scoped live orphan session transcript hits in `memory_search` when visibility permits, and keep broader private cross-conversation recall behind the separate default-off product setting?
rationale: The remaining behavior sits on a transcript privacy boundary, and the repository already has a targeted bug-fix PR plus a broader product PR that must not conflict.

options.title: Land narrow visibility fix first
options.body: Accept the targeted owner-scoped live-orphan repair, keep the existing fail-closed cross-agent/sandbox behavior, and handle automatic private recall separately.

options.title: Handle through broader recall only
options.body: Pause the narrow bug fix and resolve the behavior only through the new remember-across-private-conversations product surface.

options.title: Keep live orphan recall fail-closed
options.body: Require a session-store entry before surfacing live transcript hits, preserving the strict current boundary while leaving this gateway recall gap unresolved.

recommendation.title: Land narrow visibility fix first
recommendation.body: Accept the targeted owner-scoped live-orphan repair, keep the existing fail-closed cross-agent/sandbox behavior, and handle automatic private recall separately.

likelyOwner.reason: They own the active broader private-recall direction that needs to align with the targeted session-memory visibility fix.
